title: Four cyclic fields with accelerated cube and oriented removals

claims.statement: The explicit 4-field degree-250 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-55 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 5517672527181189553407611/100000000000000000000000000.

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), all ten averaged pair cutoffs with exact signed shell sums (1), exact child removal counts by noise weight (2), and full cumulative occupancy and error (3). The cumulative score check uses the exact oriented proper-run bounds. Part zero also checks the wide-window cube schedule, extended RAM map and fixed-cap worst-case recurrence, with eight exact reference-counter replays.
